sections.title: Talk about going somewhere
sections.content: Use ir to say where you are going. Use ir a + infinitive to say what you are going to do.

sections.title: Movement and plans
rows: I am going to the station.
I am going to take the train.

items.english: I am going to the station.
I am going to take the train.
We are going to travel tomorrow.

sections.content: Voy a + place expresses movement to a place. Voy a + infinitive expresses a future plan: Voy a la estación, but Voy a tomar el tren.
